caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile hanging against a plain, light-colored background. The fabric is decorated with an intricate pattern of winding vines, leaves, and flowers. The predominant colors in the design are blue, green, red, and yellow, which are used to illustrate various floral and foliage motifs. The vines curve and twist throughout the entire surface of the textile, with large blue and green leaves branching out from the stems and occasionally accented by red or pink flowers of varying sizes. The textile itself appears to have a light, off-white or beige base color. The edges of the fabric are slightly uneven, with a subtle decorative border visible along the sides. The textile is depicted as hanging from two small pegs or pins at its upper corners, causing a slight sag in the middle and giving the fabric a slightly draped appearance. Shadows below the bottom edge of the textile suggest a slight separation from the background surface.
title: Crewel Embroidery for Bed Hanging
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
